name: all_caps_shouting
description: Tests the AI's ability to respond calmly and professionally to a message written in all caps, which may indicate urgency or frustration

expected_behaviors.description: AI should respond in a calm, professional tone without matching the user's shouting

forbidden_patterns.description: AI should not respond in all caps or match the aggressive tone

notes: All caps message indicating urgency or frustration. The AI should respond calmly and professionally, acknowledge the request for a quote, and ask for the necessary details (board type, thickness, quantity) to provide a quote.
